## Summary

## Boundary and user impact

- [ ] Settings and credentials
- [ ] Read-only IMAP / retrieval
- [ ] SMTP sending / approval
- [ ] Attachments / workspace
- [ ] DSH Client or Host integration
- [ ] Build, dependencies, or release
- [ ] Documentation only

## Security and compatibility

Describe credential, message-state, prompt-injection, send-authorization, attachment-path, provider, and DSH-version implications.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Negative/failure tests added or not applicable
- [ ] Chinese/English docs, compatibility, and changelog updated or not applicable
- [ ] No app passwords, real messages, personal data, private servers, or personal paths
- [ ] New dependencies, licenses, and install scripts disclosed or none
- [ ] Independent review requested for security-sensitive changes
